locations.name: Shyboy Hi Fi
locations.note: Vinyl-only listening bar downtown. Two bar areas, serious sound system, natural wine and highballs. House and disco leaning. Wed–Sun, doors 6 PM. Line builds after 9 — check their calendar and RSVP ahead when there's a name on.

locations.name: It'll Do Club
locations.note: Deep Ellum institution — light-up dance floor, surround sound, and the metroplex's longest-running house and techno bookings. Thu–Sun, 9 PM–2 AM, 21+. Sunday night 'The Church' is the resident party.

locations.name: CTRL Room
locations.note: House-leaning club just off Deep Ellum, doors around 10 PM, 21+. Shares a building with Tree Haus, so there are often two different parties at one address — worth checking both before you pick a night.

locations.name: Tree Haus
locations.note: The other room at 2511 Swiss, in the same building as CTRL Room. Rotating programming — K-pop nights, after parties, DJ bookings. 21+, ID at the door.

locations.name: Double D's
locations.note: Design District dance bar — carpet on the walls, craft cocktails, resident DJs, pool and N64 in the back. Very queer-friendly, no cover. Wed–Sun 5 PM–2 AM. No kitchen, so eat first, and get there before 10 or you're in line.

locations.name: SILO Dallas
locations.note: Warehouse-scale rave room in the Design District — huge dance floor, laser rig, outdoor area with a food truck, on-site parking. Fri and Sat only, 9 PM–2 AM. Touring EDM and house bookings.

locations.name: Boogies
locations.note: Small, disco-ball-lit dance bar off Greenville. Funk, disco and house sets, crowd is there to move rather than pose. Wed–Sun 5 PM–2 AM. It fills fast — come early or plan on valet and a line.

locations.name: Green Elephant
locations.note: Upper Greenville near SMU. Indoor bar plus an outdoor stage that hosts EDM and bass bookings, often through outside promoters — check the calendar rather than walking in blind.

locations.name: Ladylove Lounge & Sound
locations.note: Record lounge in Bishop Arts. Curated nightly DJ sets with a strict no-requests policy, and one of the better bar kitchens in the city — banh mi and the fries are the order. Open daily 5 PM–2 AM, 21+. Best used as the early stop.

locations.name: Chi Chi
locations.note: Korean pocha in Carrollton that turns into a club at night — tablets at every table for ordering, games, and sending drinks to strangers, plus private karaoke rooms and a full bar. Tue–Sat 5:30 PM–2 AM. Loud and bright by design.

locations.name: CURFEW
locations.note: Downtown Fort Worth's dance bar — DJ-driven, strong cocktail program, open every night 5 PM–2 AM. The anchor if you're building a Fort Worth night instead of a Dallas one.

locations.name: Tulips FTW
locations.note: Live music venue in Near Southside with a patio bar and food truck. Books touring indie acts plus themed DJ nights. Ticketed and show-dependent, so check the calendar first. About 35–40 min from the Dallas venues.

locations.name: Downtown Dallas
locations.note: Shyboy's turf. Main St, easy rideshare pickups.

locations.name: Deep Ellum
locations.note: The nightlife spine — It'll Do on the east end, CTRL Room and Tree Haus on the northwest edge.

locations.name: Design District
locations.note: Double D's and SILO, across the river from downtown.

locations.name: Greenville Ave
locations.note: Boogies at the lower end, Green Elephant up near SMU. About 2 miles apart, so rideshare between them.

locations.name: Bishop Arts
locations.note: Ladylove's neighborhood. Parking is rough — valet or rideshare.

locations.name: Carrollton / Koreatown
locations.note: Chi Chi and the Old Denton Rd pocha strip. Roughly 25 min north of downtown Dallas.

locations.name: Downtown Fort Worth
locations.note: CURFEW and the Sundance Square blocks.

locations.name: Near Southside (FTW)
locations.note: Tulips and the Magnolia Ave corridor, just south of downtown Fort Worth.
